M1_get_body_not_registered._note: The pre-feature state of the CLI surface: the command exists, nothing registers it. Type-preserving on purpose (`void getBodyCommand;` keeps the import used, so tsc does not fail on an unused binding and the run measures behaviour rather than compilation — §A36/§A97: a BROKEN run is the absence of a measurement, not a red one).
